build_gpt_neox_transformer: build a GPT-NeoX transformer model from a GPTNeoXTransformerConfig with specified architecture parameters
build_gpt_neox_feedforward: build a GPT-NeoX feedforward MLP block with configurable activation function and hidden dimensions
build_gpt_neox_attention: build a GPT-NeoX multi-head attention block with rotary positional embeddings and causal masking
build_gpt_neox_block: build a GPT-NeoX parallel transformer block combining attention and feedforward sublayers
gpt_neox_from_huggingface_model: convert a HuggingFace GPT-NeoX model checkpoint to a Penzai TransformerLM with parameter mapping
